[CANDIDATE EQUATION]:
dk_dt = -C_eps * k**(3/2) / (L * (1 + (Re_lambda_scale / (k + k_floor)) ** (1/2))) - C_visc * nu_scale * k / (L**2) - C_inter * nu_scale * sqrt(k + k_floor) / (L * lambda_taylor_scale) * k

[CLOSED ODE SYSTEM]:

      "symbol": "k",

      "initial_condition": 0.5,
      "description": "Instantaneous integral eddy length scale with saturating self-similar growth during decay"
    }
  ]
}
(Note: this equation comes from an equation-evolution pipeline; assume it is
mathematically solvable and numerically stable.)

[NOTE ON KNOWN / CLASSICAL TERMS]:

  dk_dt = -C_eps * k**(3/2) / L
The terms appearing in this baseline equation can be regarded as the well-known classical terms for this problem.
